verdict.rationale: Oyster documents a real webhook system that pushes events to your endpoint, authenticated with a bearer secret you configure, retried up to 9 times over about 48 hours, and named so you can filter (e.g. expenses.expense_approved). However, the evidence never shows the specific payroll lifecycle events this story asks for. missing for 10: documented payroll-processed, employee-onboarded and payment-failed event types, a published event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
